note: Single source of truth for how every RWA research module got its numbers. assets/js/rwa-provenance.js renders one banner per module from this file. Adding an RWA page without an entry here fails test/rwa-provenance.mjs.

default.summary: Curated research dossier — not a live feed.
default.detail: Figures on this page are hand-compiled from the issuer and custodian disclosures listed below. They are not read from a live oracle, attestation endpoint or on-chain source, and they can go stale between reviews.

rwa-asset-score.summary: Curated issuer dossier scored by a published rubric — not a live feed.
rwa-asset-score.detail: Token and issuer attributes are hand-compiled from public issuer disclosures; the composite score is computed from them by the rubric documented in the methodology. Nothing on this page is read live from an oracle or attestation endpoint.

issuer-due-diligence.summary: Curated issuer dossier — not a live feed.
issuer-due-diligence.detail: Counterparty, domicile and track-record figures are hand-compiled from issuer filings and public disclosures at the review date below.

custody-por.summary: Curated custody dossier — statuses are issuer-reported, not independently verified by DeFi Scoring.
custody-por.detail: Custodian, attestation status and reserve figures are transcribed from the issuer's and custodian's own published reports at the review date. A status of "Verified" means the issuer's attestation provider reported it — DeFi Scoring does not perform the attestation and does not read proof-of-reserves on-chain.
sources: Custodian SOC 2 reports and custody agreements

oracle-integrity.summary: Curated oracle dossier — not a live feed.
oracle-integrity.detail: Feed inventory, freshness and failure history are hand-compiled from oracle provider documentation and public incident write-ups. Values are not sampled live from the oracles themselves.

liquidity-redemption.summary: Curated redemption-terms dossier — not a live feed.
liquidity-redemption.detail: Redemption windows, gates and liquidity figures are transcribed from issuer terms at the review date. On-chain liquidity is not sampled live on this page.
sources: Issuer redemption terms and subscription agreements

legal-compliance.summary: Curated regulatory dossier — research summary, not legal advice.
legal-compliance.detail: Jurisdiction, licensing and transfer-restriction summaries are hand-compiled from public regulatory records at the review date. This is a research summary, not legal advice, and regulatory status can change without notice.
sources: Public regulator registers and enforcement records

portfolio-rwa-exposure.summary: Issuer profiles are a curated dossier; holdings are live when a wallet is connected.
portfolio-rwa-exposure.detail: Detected holdings come from the connected wallet. When no wallet is connected the page shows a clearly labelled representative portfolio. The per-issuer risk attributes applied to those holdings are hand-compiled research, not a live feed.

yield-risk-adjusted.summary: Curated yield dossier — not a live rate feed.
yield-risk-adjusted.detail: Advertised yields and the risk attributes used to adjust them are hand-compiled from issuer disclosures at the review date. Rates are not polled live and will drift.

audit-toolkit.summary: Exports carry the same provenance as the modules they read.
audit-toolkit.detail: This toolkit assembles the figures already rendered by the other RWA modules. Every exported figure inherits that module's curated-dossier status and review date — check them before circulating an export.
sources: The RWA research modules listed in each export

rwa-chatbot.summary: The advisor answers from curated research dossiers — not a live feed.
rwa-chatbot.detail: This assistant reasons over the same hand-compiled issuer, custody and regulatory dossiers used by the other RWA modules. It has no live market, attestation or on-chain data, it can be wrong, and nothing it says is investment or legal advice.
sources: The curated RWA research dossiers used across this section
